description: Source file for utility functions related to 'exploder' features in the Wesnoth game, including image processing, surface manipulation, and file path retrieval.

classes.name: exploder_point
classes.description: Represents a point with x and y coordinates, initialized from a string.

classes.name: exploder_rect
classes.description: Represents a rectangle with position and size, initialized from a string.

methods.name: exploder_point::exploder_point
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a point from a string.

methods.name: exploder_rect::exploder_rect
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a rectangle from a string.

methods.name: get_mask_dir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for mask images.

methods.name: get_exploder_dir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for exploder data.

methods.name: masked_overwrite_surface
methods.description: Overwrites pixels in the destination surface with source surface pixels based on a mask, at a specified position.

methods.name: image_empty
methods.description: Checks if a surface is empty (all pixels transparent or uniform).

methods.name: save_image
methods.description: Saves an SDL surface as a PNG image file.
